subject: ClearingPoint inference cost recap & pilot framing
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: ClearingPoint SRE <sre@clearingpoint.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearingPoint inference cost recap & pilot framing

Hi Ayesha —

Thanks again for a really practical call this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh and to make next steps explicit:

1) Key pain & goals (what I heard)
- Latency-sensitive document classification pipeline for claims processing (95th pct target ~150ms).
- Current spend on running open checkpoints + in-house infra has unpredictable bursts that blow monthly budget.
- Need a predictable TCO for a pilot that demonstrates 30–40% per-token cost reduction while meeting latency SLOs.

2) Cost levers we discussed (how Redwood helps)
- Batching: dynamic batching for throughput-heavy periods; expected 10–18% token-cost reduction depending on concurrency.
- Prefix/KV caching: helpful for repeated templates in claims — estimated 12–25% savings on generation tokens.
- Model variants & quantization: switching to a 8-bit quantized candidate for non-critical steps reduces GPU cost ~20% (quality trade-offs noted).
- Smart routing: fall back to lower-cost variants for non-critical batch windows to preserve SLA while saving run costs.

3) Pilot scope proposal (recommended next step)
- 4-week pilot against a narrowed workflow (claims classification + two templated responses).
- Baseline capture: we need the last 7 days of production traffic sample (CSV). You offered a sanitized snapshot on the call — that's perfect.
- Success criteria: 30% net per-token cost saving without pushing 95th-pct latency over 150ms, and no more than 2% degradation on the classification accuracy metric you use today.

4) Budget & commercial framing
- Rough estimate: for a pilot sized like your sample, expected hosted estimate is in the attached PDF (redwood_estimate_Q2.pdf). Ballpark monthly run-rate after pilot with optimizations: $6–8k for the production min-slice; pilot commitment can be scoped as a time-limited reserved pool.
- If budget is constrained, we can scope to an eval-only batch window to prove caching/batching savings first (cheaper ramp).

5) Next steps & owners
- Ayesha: share sanitized usage snapshot (CSV) by EOD Monday so we can size the pilot.
- Connor (me): stand up a pilot proposal & pricing sheet and run a quick perf simulation; deliver by Wed.
- Marissa: I'll loop you for pricing guardrails and SLA language.

Attachments: clearingpoint_usage_snapshot.csv (placeholder you mentioned), redwood_estimate_Q2.pdf (initial pricing sketch).

If that aligns, I'll draft a one-page mutual action plan and calendar a 30-min kickoff for next Thurs.

Thanks —
